articles.title: 'HOLY F*UCK, We're Out Of Time': Florida Jet Crew’s Final Audio Message Before Deadly Crash
articles.description: Chilling air traffic control audio captures the final moments of a doomed aircraft over Florida as its pilots repeatedly declare an emergency and report an extreme descent. “May Day! May Day!” one crew member says while reporting a descent of 10,000 feet per minute. Moments later, the pilot says the aircraft is falling at 20,000 feet per minute before warning: “We’re going to crash into the ground.” The controller responds, “I’m here with you. Talk to me.” The crew then reports descending at 22,000 feet per minute. Screams are heard, followed by “Look outside!” and the final words: “We’re out of time.” The controller continues calling the aircraft — “November Two Bravo Delta, how do you hear?” — but receives no further response.

articles.title: Iran's Tit-for-Tat Strike On 'Enemy' Britain: UK Navy, Air Force Now Terrorists, MI6 On Hostile List
articles.description: Iran has just crossed a line few expected. Tehran has declared Britain’s Royal Navy and Royal Air Force terrorist organisations, and placed MI6 on its hostile group list. The Foreign Ministry announced it on November 1, saying the Supreme National Security Council approved the move as retaliation for Britain’s designation of the IRGC on July 13. London insists it is countering espionage, sabotage, intimidation and proxy attacks on British soil. Tehran says Britain joined the US-Israeli war by offering bases and logistics. This is not the first time: in February 2026, Iran targeted the naval and air forces of all 27 EU states. So is this just a signal, or the start of something dangerous? Shreya Chandra breaks down the legal weapon of reciprocity, what it means for diplomacy, and why labels in a crisis can quickly become real threats. Watch this analysis till the very end for the full picture.

articles.title: Rally Countdown: Three Open Buses Ready at Kharge’s Residence for INDIA Alliance Leaders
articles.description: Preparations for the INDIA alliance rally are underway at both Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence and Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan. At Kharge’s residence, three open buses have been arranged to transport INDIA alliance floor leaders towards the rally venue. According to the report, the leaders will travel first to Minto Bridge before proceeding towards Ramlila Maidan. The buses carry the slogans “Delhi Chalo,” “Desh Bachao” and “Vote Bachao,” reflecting the Opposition’s campaign message. Meanwhile, ABP News correspondent Pawan Gaur reported from Ramlila Maidan that participants had started arriving gradually by around 9:30 AM. The front section of the venue, prepared for the gathering, was almost filled, while more workers were expected to arrive as the day progressed. The main rally programme is scheduled to begin at 12 noon. Preparations were also underway on the stage, with leaders and security personnel beginning to arrive. Senior leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, are expected to attend. The report highlights the final arrangements for the Opposition’s major political gathering in the national capital.
